Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with the indication 'hypertension'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join drug_indication to indication_refs on drugind_id to retrieve the EFO ID (indication_curie) and indication label. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (EFO ID), indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
